# `responsive` (Layout)

<!-- GENERATED by `dart run tool/reference.dart`. Do not edit. -->

Shows `wide` when the available width reaches `breakpoint`, else `narrow`. Use it to switch a row of columns to a stack on phones.

| Prop | Kind | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `narrow` | node |  |
| `wide` | node |  |
| `breakpoint` | literal | in logical pixels, default 720 |

Kinds are explained in REFERENCE.md (Widgets). Icons, colors and text variants: style.md.
